natural_body: Price-sensitive SMBs: 40% off drove signup +31%, revenue +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, while two inherited findings indicate that shorter, simpler onboarding improves completion, time-to-value, and early activation. This directly addresses both deteriorating metrics. Promotional pricing responds to the competitor but carries documented retention deterioration, creating risk to sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Verify the strongest onboarding record and the pricing tradeoff before committing; run with downstream retention and qualified-revenue guardrails.
